Edit ONLY these four files, replacing their entire content: resources/js/modules/leaveapprovalsupervisor/index.js, leaveapprovalhod/index.js, leaveapprovaldir/index.js, leaveapprovalhr/index.js. Each file gets the same structure (differences noted per module): start with `const { route, url, old, errors } = window.data;` then: (1) `var table = $('#leaveapproval-' + window.data.type).DataTable({ ...config.datatable, processing: true, serverSide: false, ajax: { url: url.table, dataSrc: 'data' }, columns: [ {data:'leave_no_link'},{data:'username'},{data:'name'},{data:'leave_type_code'},{data:'reason'},{data:'date_applied'},{data:'dts'},{data:'dte'},{data:'dper'},{data:'bapp'}, {data:'supp'},{data:'hodd'},{data:'dirr'}, {data:'approve', orderable:false} ], columnDefs: [ { type: 'date', targets: [5,6,7] } ], order: [[6, 'desc']], paging: false, rowCallback: function(row, data){ if (data.DT_RowClass) $(row).addClass(data.DT_RowClass); }, initComplete: function(){ $('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]').tooltip({ ...config.tooltip }); } });` - NOTE: for the supervisor, hod and dir modules use ONLY the columns list WITHOUT supp/hodd/dirr: [{data:'leave_no_link'},{data:'username'},{data:'name'},{data:'leave_type_code'},{data:'reason'},{data:'date_applied'},{data:'dts'},{data:'dte'},{data:'dper'},{data:'bapp'},{data:'approve', orderable:false}]; only the hr module includes {data:'supp'},{data:'hodd'},{data:'dirr'} before approve. (2) approve-button handler (delegated): `$(document).on('click', '.approve-btn', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); var $btn = $(this); var id = $btn.data('id'); var rowData = table.row($btn.closest('tr')).data(); if (!rowData || !rowData.modal_html) return; var $modal = $(rowData.modal_html); $('body').append($modal); var el = document.getElementById(window.data.type + 'approval' + id); var modal = new bootstrap.Modal(el); modal.show(); $modal.on('hidden.bs.modal', function () { $modal.remove(); }); });` (3) form submit handler (delegated): `$(document).on('submit', '.form', async function (e) { e.preventDefault(); var form = $(this); var ids = form.data('id'); try { var response = await $.ajax({ url: route.patch, type: 'PATCH', data: { id: ids, leave_status_id: form.find('input[name="leave_status_id"]:checked').val(), verify_code: form.find('input[name="verify_code"]').val(), remarks: form.find('textarea[name="remarks"]').val() }, dataType: 'json' }); $('#' + window.data.type + 'approval' + ids).modal('hide'); swal.fire('Success!', response.message, 'success'); table.ajax.reload(); } catch (err) { var res = err.responseJSON ?? { message: 'Unknown error' }; swal.fire('Error!', res.message, 'error'); } });` (4) tooltip init on document ready: `$(document).ready(function(){ $('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]').tooltip({ ...config.tooltip }); });`. IMPORTANT: bootstrap and swal and config are already global (loaded via webpack - the other modules like salescustomer/index.js use them the same way). Do NOT touch any PHP files.
